# imstruzik.com

> Marcin Struzik — 13+ years in SaaS product marketing video. Scripting, video editing,
> motion design and UI animation. Writes practical notes on using AI in a real video
> production workflow: what saves time, what wastes it, and what stays human.

## The AI Cut

All notes: https://imstruzik.com/notes/

- [Free AI Tools for Video Creators: The Resources I Actually Use](https://imstruzik.com/notes/free-ai-video-tools/): free, no-affiliate-link tools for scripting, voiceover, captions, stock footage and mockups, with free-tier limits noted.
- [How to Write an AI Video Script People Watch to the End](https://imstruzik.com/notes/ai-video-script/): where AI speeds up scripting and the one decision that still has to come from a person.
- [AI Video Editing: 7 Tasks to Hand Over Today, and 3 You Never Should](https://imstruzik.com/notes/ai-video-editing/): which editing tasks are safe to automate, and which ones only look finished.
- [The AI Tools for Video I Stopped Using, and the 4 I Would Keep](https://imstruzik.com/notes/ai-tools-for-video/): a working shortlist after testing tools on real client work, not demos.
